title: Native geometric localizing hull, compact-support functor and chosen compactification
statement:
Use the native coefficient categories, geometric fibers, bounded constructible predicate and ordinary derived operations of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell$ and a $k_0$-scheme $T$, write $\bar T=T\times_{k_0}\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(k_0)$, $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{AdicSheaf}_\ell(\bar T)$ and $C_T\subset D(\mathcal A_T)$ for the full subcategory of bounded native constructible objects. Define $L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(C_T)$: an object belongs to $L_T$ if it belongs to every full replete triangulated subcategory [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory] containing $C_T$ and closed under coproducts indexed in the Hom universe. This is Lean `AlgebraicGeometry.nativeWeilUnderlyingHull k₀ ℓ T`.

For $k_0$-schemes $X,Y$, a $k_0$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ and any compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow Z,p:Z\to Y)$ of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], equip $Z$ with its $k_0$-structure through $p$. Define the ordinary geometric compact-support functor $F_c=D(\bar j_!)\,;\,R\bar p_*:D(\mathcal A_X)\to D(\mathcal A_Y)$, where the first functor is termwise extension by zero and the second is the total right derived native module direct image; coefficient maps are the native precomposition maps on locally finite functions. This is Lean `AlgebraicGeometry.nativeWeilUnderlyingCompactSupport k₀ ℓ f c`.

For any field $k_0$, a $k_0$-scheme $Y$ with quasi-compact quasi-separated structure map, and a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$, define $c_f$ to be exactly `HasCompactification.compactification f` with the witness `hasCompactification_of_over (k₀ := k₀) f`. This is Lean `AlgebraicGeometry.nativeWeilChosenCompactification k₀ f`. Thus the functor used for $f$ over a finite field is $F_{c_f}$, with this very compactification; no preservation or adjoint-existence assertion is part of these definitions.
